reason: Reproduced the exact reported diagnostic using installed uv 0.13.7, CPython 3.12.3, Linux x86_64, and host glibc 2.39. In a temporary project with pandas>=3.1.1, requires-python>=3.12, and the reported tool.uv configuration (no-build, minimum-libc-version preview, glibc 2.20, Linux x86_64 environments), `uv lock --python /usr/bin/python3 --default-index https://pypi.org/simple` exits 1, claiming pandas lacks Linux/x86_64-compatible wheels without mentioning glibc. Changing only the configured baseline to 2.28 succeeds with pandas 3.1.1. Public PyPI metadata confirms manylinux 2.24/2.28 x86_64 wheels exist. Wheel rejection is expected; the reproduced problem is the omitted libc explanation. Existing tests minimum_libc_no_compatible_version and minimum_libc_allows_sdist_fallback in crates/uv/tests/lock/minimum_libc.rs snapshot the same omission. Reported uv 0.13.8 was not separately tested. Updated $RUNNER_TEMP/issue-context/README.md; checkout and GitHub unchanged.
